definitions.explanation: Arranged in a proper, systematic manner; tidy and methodical.

examples.japanese: {整然|せいぜん}と{並|なら}んでいる。
examples.english: They are lined up in an orderly manner.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}は{整然|せいぜん}と{片付|かたづ}いていた。
{整然|せいぜん}とした{行列|ぎょうれつ}が{続|つづ}いた。

notes:
{整然|せいぜん} describes something well-organized and orderly, used as a taru-adjective.

GRAMMATICAL FORMS:
- {整然|せいぜん}と + verb: orderly (adverb)
- {整然|せいぜん}とした + noun: orderly (prenominal)
- {整然|せいぜん}たる + noun: orderly (literary)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整然|せいぜん}と{並|なら}ぶ: to line up in an orderly way
- {整然|せいぜん}とした{行列|ぎょうれつ}: orderly queue/procession
- {整然|せいぜん}と{片付|かたづ}ける: to tidy up neatly

USAGE:
- Formal or written style
- Implies systematic organization
- Positive connotation
